climate_relevance: Regional grid generation mix affects the emissions associated with electricity.
primary_boundary: EPA eGRID 2023 CAMX subregion generation factor.
comparison_rule: Regional average, not a company procurement factor or company emissions total.

climate_relevance: Reported sector emissions provide broad industrial context.
comparison_rule: Includes non-semiconductor electronics activity and reporting thresholds; not company-level.

climate_relevance: Operational and purchased-energy emissions contribute to reported GHG totals.
primary_boundary: Samsung Device Solutions division; Scope 1 plus market-based Scope 2.
comparison_rule: Division is broader than semiconductor foundry operations; not a single-fab value.

climate_relevance: Fab water demand can affect local water resources and treatment needs.
comparison_rule: Not a global company total; do not combine with recycling volume.

climate_relevance: Operational energy demand can drive indirect and direct emissions.
primary_boundary: TSMC company operations; includes purchased electricity, natural gas, and diesel.
comparison_rule: Do not label as electricity-only or compare with a generation emissions factor.

metric: Water consumption per 12-inch equivalent wafer mask layer
unit: L per 12-inch equivalent wafer mask layer
climate_relevance: Production-normalized water use provides intensity context.
primary_boundary: TSMC company-reported wafer-equivalent intensity; photomask-count basis.
comparison_rule: Compare only with the same functional and normalization basis; not an absolute volume.

climate_relevance: Recycling can reduce freshwater demand, but volume alone does not show local scarcity.
primary_boundary: TSMC recovery systems; company-reported recycled volume.
comparison_rule: Not equivalent to water withdrawal or water consumption.
